$$不動$$
「I have surely conveyed it, the heart」

stage0099_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$不動$$
「The 'Book of Twin Stars' isn't over yet...
　It becomes the blue star...」

stage0099_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Feelings! Will! Life! Light!
　The fact that you can turn those into energy...!」

stage0099_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You people...!
　Have you already reached Z's endgame!」

stage0099_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You have some kind of plan, don't you!」

stage0099_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go!
　This is where the real fight starts!!」

stage0099_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$シモン$$
「This ends it, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!」

stage0099_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シモン$$
「The ones who win... are uuuus!!」

stage0099_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Why!
　Why won't you understand!
　Why do you try to evolve!?」

stage0099_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$n
「That's because we're alive...!
　Because we're human!」

stage0099_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$シモン$$
「We evolve beyond who we were a minute ago!
　One turn moves us forward, just a little!
　That's what a drill is!」

stage0099_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That is the path to ruin!
　Why won't you see the Spiral race's limits!」

stage0099_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's you who hasn't grasped the truth!」

stage0099_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not you who decides the limit!」

stage0099_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$アルト$$
「When the limit comes, we smash through it!」

stage0099_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$シモン$$
「You decided your own limit yourself!
　That's nothing but the limit of you, playing king
　and sealing away other lives in this closed-off universe!」

stage0099_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's right!
　Even among humans, there were bigger guys than that!
　We move forward for their sakes too!」

stage0099_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ニア$$
「A person's heart is limitless!
　I bet on that vastness too!」

stage0099_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Such a thiiing!!」

stage0099_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$シモン$$
「Remember this!
　This drill bores a hole through the universe!
　That hole becomes the path for those who follow!」

stage0099_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$シモン$$
「The wishes of those who fell, and the hopes of those who follow!
　I weave both feelings into a double helix
　and dig the path to tomorrow!」

stage0099_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's Tengen Toppa!
　That's $$グレンラガン$$!
　My drill is... the drill that creates the heaaavens!!」

stage0099_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I won't accept it! I refuse to accept it!
　That's nothing but a useless struuuggle!!」

stage0099_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$シモン$$
「Even so, I...! I believe...!
　In the us that I believe in...!」

stage0099_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$シモン$$
「In humanity...! In the future...! I believe...!
　The drill is...! Mine!」

stage0099_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Do you understand?
　What awaits after this is the Primal Catastrophe」

stage0099_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Then this universe... you'd better protect it...」

stage0099_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Of course...
　You believe in us too... in humanity...」

stage0099_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ニア$$...
　I won't forget about you.
　Even if this universe is destroyed...」

stage0099_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah, me too...
　I love you, $$ニア$$...」

stage0099_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ダリー$$
「$$ニア$$...
　are you going to disappear...?」

stage0099_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ギミー$$
「No way!
　Weren't you supposed to be alright!?」

stage0099_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ギミー$$
「That can't be!
　There's no way that can be, dammiiit!!」

stage0099_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「$$ニア$$, a virtual life form,
　loses her own eternity along with the
　disappearance of her creator, the $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$...」

stage0099_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Wasn't it supposed to have vanished!?」

stage0099_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「When I converted Anti-Spiral energy into
　Spiral energy, my existence took on my will
　and temporarily multiplied」

stage0099_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Because of that, even though I once lost
　my body, I was able to remain in existence
　as data like this」

stage0099_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「$$ニア$$...
　You are no longer an eternal being」

stage0099_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Your existence has begun to collapse.
　Even if you survive today, there's no
　guarantee you'll live to see tomorrow」

stage0099_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ニア$$
「I don't mind.
　I'll live out my limited time with care」

stage0099_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ニア$$
「Every life is the same, not knowing
　if there's a tomorrow. I'll spend
　that time together with $$シモン$$」

stage0099_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Heh... compared to eternity, what a
　short and fleeting life」

stage0099_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ニア$$
「I don't need an eternity given to me by someone else」

stage0099_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ニア$$
「$$シモン$$...
　I don't know when the time for
　our farewell will come...」

stage0099_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ニア$$
「It may be a short time, but
　please continue to take care of me」

stage0099_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's live that time together, the two of us!
　With everything we've got!」

stage0099_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$シモン$$
「You heard it, everyone!
　I'm going to live together with $$ニア$$!」

stage0099_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$シモン$$
「A limited time...
　But an irreplaceable time...!
　In the world we protected!」

stage0099_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$キリコ$$
（...$$フィアナ$$...
　It's the same as when you
　denied eternity too...）

stage0099_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$桂$$
「...Guess it's time to go home then.
　To our star, where the people who
　matter to us are waiting」

stage0099_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$赤木$$
「Yeah.
　The way back is visible too」

stage0099_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$葵$$
「Once we pass through that hole in space, it's Earth」

stage0099_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We can go home...!
　We can really go home!」

stage0099_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「...Come to think of it, I never
　noticed with all the fighting, but
　this universe... it's beautiful」

stage0099_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$シモン$$
「Every light reflected in our eyes is a star...
　And they're overflowing with life」

stage0099_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The light of the stars filling the galaxy...」

stage0099_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Even if you're children, I can't overlook it!
　I will crush your potential here!」

stage0099_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are the people of Earth really so bad that
　we deserve to be destroyed by some
　selfish logic like that!」

stage0099_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It's not a matter of good or evil.
　It is fate」

stage0099_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then all the more reason!
　There's no way we'll lose to selfish logic like that!」

stage0099_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$木下$$
「Let's go all out, all out!」

stage0099_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Once this fight is over, delicious snacks will be waiting!」

stage0099_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　Whatever you say, I'll protect Earth's
　peace and our company's vault!!」

stage0099_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You, who have broken through the universe's
　dark will, should be able to
　understand what I'm saying」

stage0099_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$タケル$$
「The despair surrounding the $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$...!
　Is this resignation to fate!」

stage0099_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「But that is the only means
　to keep the universe alive!」

stage0099_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$タケル$$
「Taking others' lives and making them suffer
　is no means of heading toward the future!」

stage0099_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$ロゼ$$
（The feelings $$マーグ#pilot$$ left behind
　still live on inside Mars, even now...!
　And that becomes strength!）

stage0099_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　We won't yield to you, or to the despairing
　future you speak of!」

stage0099_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's why we fight with everything we have!
　This is our life... the power of the living!!」

stage0099_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You who carry the power of the sun!
　Understand that your very existence invites tragedy!」

stage0099_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Whatever awaits in the future, we'll move forward!
　Believing a better world than now will come!」

stage0099_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「If the despair you speak of comes,
　we'll join forces and fight with everything we have!
　With the power of $$鉄人$$!」

stage0099_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Still don't understand!
　True despair is not something
　that can be overcome by that alone!」

stage0099_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll gather our strength to overcome it!
　That's why we can't afford
　to lose here!」

stage0099_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　We're fighting to move forward into the future!!」

stage0099_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You $$異能生存体$$.
　A death, an annihilation, a despair even you can't overcome,
　await you ahead!」

stage0099_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Understand!
　To avoid that,
　you must be erased here!」

stage0099_04:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Even if you were a god...
　and even if my opponent were fate itself...」

stage0099_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「True singularity!
　Your existence ends here!
　That's also to protect the universe!」

stage0099_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$モーム$$
「Master $$桂$$...!
　That man's saying something!」

stage0099_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$桂$$
「I won't claim my life outweighs the universe,
　but I've got no intention of following that kind of unreasonable logic!」

stage0099_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Just as I thought!
　You don't understand your own mission!」

stage0099_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$桂$$
「My mission is to love someone, to fight to protect them,
　and to live life to its fullest!」

stage0099_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$桂$$
「Anyone who gets in the way of that,
　whoever they are, I'll resist with everything I've got!」

stage0099_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$桂$$
「While I'm at it!
　I'll knock some sense into that thick skull
　hardened by pessimism!!」

stage0099_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You who bear the seed of evolution!
　Know that you have no future!」

stage0099_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Do you have the right to decide that!?」

stage0099_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Only I, who sacrificed everything to become
　this universe's administrator, can stop the Spiral Nemesis!」

stage0099_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're just like the Colonel used to be!
　Convinced that only you know,
　only you can do it!」

stage0099_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't run to the easy idea
　of cutting something away to save something else!」

stage0099_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Are you saying what I'm doing is wrong!?」

stage0099_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no way a method that unilaterally
　steals someone's future could be right!」

stage0099_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we resist!
　To protect life and move toward the future!!」

stage0099_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The very appearance of a man like you
　leads your planet... and by extension, the whole universe, to crisis!」

stage0099_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you talking about the Newtype awakening!?」

stage0099_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That's right!
　The universe has no need for the age of the sun!」

stage0099_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If you deny life itself,
　then I'll fight you!」

stage0099_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Humanity moves forward!
　If despair is what's waiting at the end of that road,
　human wisdom will overcome it!」

stage0099_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You fool!
　If that were possible, I'd have done it long ago!」

stage0099_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Then I'll defeat you!
　To prove that we can do what you couldn't!」

stage0099_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Someday, people should be able to master even time itself!
　I'll see that day come with my own eyes!」

stage0099_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You're a foolish man!
　You touched a fragment of that despairing fate,
　yet you couldn't stop humanity!」

stage0099_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You're just like that man, $$ロージェノム$$!
　One who lacks rational judgment and gambles on recklessness
　called a dream has no right to lead humanity!」

stage0099_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'm no vessel fit to lead humanity!
　The most I can do is give humanity a chance to choose!
　And even that, by foolish means!」

stage0099_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'll make up for it!
　In this fight to protect humanity's future!」

stage0099_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$シャア$$
「By defeating you, the despair standing in our way!」

stage0099_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You too, who saw the future through
　the Zero System's power, must know despair awaits!」

stage0099_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What meaning is there in that?」

stage0099_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If an unwanted future comes, I'll simply change it with my own power」

stage0099_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The woman I know
　has tried to change the world that way」

stage0099_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It's futile!
　Such a thing is impossible!」

stage0099_04:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You can't do it.
　But we'll prove it can be done」

stage0099_04:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's why I won't let the world end!」

stage0099_04:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Target confirmed.
　Attack target, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!」

stage0099_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The very fact that you keep fighting like this
　is leading the universe to destruction!」

stage0099_04:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$シン$$
「So you're saying you'll destroy the Earth... destroy us!?」

stage0099_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$シン$$
「There's no way I'll accept that!
　Someone who can't protect the life being taken right in front of them
　could never protect the whole universe!」

stage0099_04:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Are you saying you'll protect the universe in my place!?」

stage0099_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$シン$$
「I don't know if I can pull off something so grand...
　But I'll keep fighting to protect peace!」

stage0099_04:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$シン$$
「No matter who it is, no matter how huge the enemy!
　So, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　I'll be the one to face you!!」

stage0099_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Why don't any of you understand my words!
　Are you not afraid of despair!?」

stage0099_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$キラ$$
「I've... we've broken through despair many times before!
　This time will be no different!」

stage0099_04:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Naive!
　What awaits you on the path ahead
　is terror beyond imagination and overwhelming power!」

stage0099_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$キラ$$
「If we give in to that,
　the lives of the people of Earth will be lost!
　I... I won't accept that!」

stage0099_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Then you will die!
　That's the only path left to you!」

stage0099_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$キラ$$
「I... will live!
　I'll live, and do everything I can!」

stage0099_04:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$キラ$$
「That's the meaning of my being alive!
　I won't lose to the despair you speak of!」

stage0099_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$刹那$$
「Why did you keep the truth about
　the Spiral Nemesis hidden from us!」

stage0099_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$刹那$$
「If we'd pooled this universe's collective wisdom,
　we might have found a way to avoid it!」

stage0099_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I abandoned that obvious choice long ago!
　The only way to save the universe is the method I chose!」

stage0099_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$刹那$$
「Do you have the right to decide that!?」

stage0099_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It's not that I wanted to do this!
　You too, a pioneer yourself, would surely
　have come to understand my solitude!」

stage0099_04:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$刹那$$
「I have... companions!
　Companions who fight alongside me and believe in the future!」

stage0099_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$刹那$$
「You were never able to understand anyone else!
　I can't hand this universe's future
　over to someone like that!」

stage0099_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Understand each other!?
　As if something like that could save the universe!」

stage0099_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$刹那$$
「I believe!
　That the bonds between people can become the power to change something!」

stage0099_04:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$刹那$$
「That's why I fight!
　We'll protect the future using the very method you denied!」

stage0099_04:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What you're trying to do is a denial of every possibility!」

stage0099_04:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Possibility doesn't exist!
　If you're left as you are,
　certain ruin is what awaits!」

stage0099_04:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The possibility to avoid that lies within us!
　Are you going to deny even that!?」

stage0099_04:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That's right!
　Wishful thinking means nothing!
　All that exists is plain fact!」

stage0099_04:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so!
　Even so, we live!
　And we protect the world!」

stage0099_04:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The possibility that lies beyond! The future!
　I want to believe in them!!」

stage0099_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You who carry the blood of beasts!
　Your very existence is a sign of the Spiral Nemesis!」

stage0099_04:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Not just you!
　All of humanity on that planet!」

stage0099_04:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$くらら$$
「If you think that'll solve the problem,
　you're dead wrong!」

stage0099_04:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$朔哉$$
「What you're trying to do
　is just putting a lid on something that stinks!」

stage0099_04:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's not a fundamental solution.
　It's nothing more than a stopgap escape」

stage0099_04:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「We won't accept your way of doing things!」

stage0099_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I have no intention of asking for your permission!
　I am the one who protects the universe!」

stage0099_04:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$葵$$
「If you're going to take that attitude,
　it just means we get to punch you without holding back!」

stage0099_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$葵$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　If this is the final battle, we'll throw everything we've got at it!」

stage0099_04:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Despair!? Ruin!?
　My song will blow away a future that dark!」

stage0099_04:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「A song...
　The power of life we abandoned in the distant past...」

stage0099_04:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Remember, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　Even you must have once had a heart
　that could feel a song, didn't you!」

stage0099_04:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Just listen to $$バサラ$$'s song, it's simple!
　Bring that shattered heart back to life again!」

stage0099_04:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「No! No, no, no! Absolutely not!
　What I've done can't be wrong!」

stage0099_04:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「This explosion of life's power
　will eventually call forth the Primal Catastrophe upon living things!」

stage0099_04:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't sit there overthinking things just to listen to a song!
　Feel it with your heart!」

stage0099_04:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Whoaaaaa!
　O stars! O galaxy!
　Liiisten to my soooong!!」

stage0099_04:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$アルト$$
「What do you think you're doing!
　Just because you want to protect the universe,
　there's no way a method that takes someone's life could be right!」

stage0099_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Still can't understand!?
　That's the only method there is!」

stage0099_04:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's just an excuse!
　I won't let someone who's forgotten how to love another
　and only chases efficiency have their way with our Earth!」

stage0099_04:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Love...!? Love, you say...!
　What meaning is there in an emotion like that!」

stage0099_04:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$アルト$$
「There's no way I'll lose
　to someone who doesn't understand that!」

stage0099_04:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll defeat you on these two wings!
　Protecting the people who matter to me, that's my fight!!」

stage0099_04:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Once it's come this far, we don't need reasons anymore!
　Let's settle this, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!」

stage0099_04:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You warrior chosen by the Getter rays!
　Are you denying my methods!?」

stage0099_04:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「I can't understand
　continuing an endless fight the way you do!」

stage0099_04:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$隼人$$
「I'll tell you now, someone who'd destroy
　not just other worlds but even their own kind
　over selfish logic like yours, I can't understand either」

stage0099_04:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$弁慶$$
「I'll tell you something else while I'm at it.
　Asking $$竜馬$$ why he fights
　is a pointless thing to do」

stage0099_04:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If there's an enemy there, I fight and beat them!
　That's my life!」

stage0099_04:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Even if it's a fight that goes on forever!?」

stage0099_04:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bring it on!
　Living means fighting!」

stage0099_04:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here we go, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　Our fight against you, with the galaxy as the stage...!」

stage0099_04:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You who inherit the power of the god of light!
　That even that power can't defeat every foe...
　know the cruelty of what's called fate!」

stage0099_04:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$甲児$$
「There's no way I and Mazinger
　would lose to someone who's given up on things like you!」

stage0099_04:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「That ignorance itself is sin! That recklessness itself is evil!
　For you, who've only just touched a fragment of the universe's truth,
　is any further explanation pointless!?」

stage0099_04:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$甲児$$
「Sounds like you've given up trying to talk me down!」

stage0099_04:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$甲児$$
「This time, I'll make you give up
　trying to force us down by brute strength!」

stage0099_04:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$甲児$$
「We will never give up!
　That's what becomes the light that lights the future... hope!」

stage0099_04:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is a duel, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　Mazinger and I will shatter that darkness that is you!!」

stage0099_04:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$赤木$$
「Whatever you say about the end of the universe,
　I will absolutely stop what you're trying to do!」

stage0099_04:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「A fool caught up in petty, short-sighted things
　dares to deny me!?」

stage0099_04:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's not some petty, short-sighted thing!
　The lives we're trying to protect lead to the future!」

stage0099_04:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Those lives might do something
　to overcome what you call the Spiral Nemesis!
　Or maybe they'll keep it from ever happening at all!」

stage0099_04:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$赤木$$
「What you're trying to do
　rips out every last one of those possibilities, root and all!」

stage0099_04:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's surprisingly logical, coming from you, $$赤木$$」

stage0099_04:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$青山$$
「If you fear the chance of the Spiral Nemesis,
　then believing in the chance to overcome it
　is just as valid. So, I'd rather bet on the latter」

stage0099_04:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You think such wishful thinking will get you anywhere!?」

stage0099_04:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$赤木$$
「Then don't you go spouting hopeless thinking either!
　We'll put a stop to your armchair logic!」

stage0099_04:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$赤木$$
「Here we go!
　Even an office worker can protect peace in the universe!!」

stage0099_04:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even I, who takes pride in my duty as a negotiator,
　have no intention of talking with you anymore」

stage0099_04:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「So you'll force your own logic through
　under ignorance and blind faith!?」

stage0099_04:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not it, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$.
　I believe I understand both your resolve and your sorrow」

stage0099_04:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But I cannot agree with you.
　It's my policy not to live pessimistically,
　nor to drag others into it」

stage0099_04:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「You truly are free, $$ロジャー$$」

stage0099_04:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's right.
　And I intend to enjoy living freely!」

stage0099_04:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Even if it means the end of the universe!?」

stage0099_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Freedom always comes with responsibility!
　Together with my friends, I intend to face that too!
　And to do so, first I'll get past you, the wall in my way!」

stage0099_04:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's my duty... $$ロジャー・スミス$$'s duty!
　$$ビッグオー$$, Aaaction!!」

stage0099_04:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「As one of the successors yourself,
　you must sense that despair is coming to this universe」

stage0099_04:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have no words for one who does nothing but avert their eyes from it」

stage0099_04:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You mean to deny my methods!?
　Then show me another way!」

stage0099_04:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Do you intend to use the System's power
　and live on in another form!?」

stage0099_04:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Stopping time, is it...
　That is what I have always denied!」

stage0099_04:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「What I want isn't the past, or even the present!
　It's the future!」

stage0099_04:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（Heh... That's exactly like you, $$ルルーシュ$$）

stage0099_04:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$スザク$$
（It's because you're like that, that we believed in you）

stage0099_04:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$カレン$$
（That's why we'll fight alongside you!）

stage0099_04:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Listen, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　I am $$ゼロ$$! A man who makes miracles happen!」

stage0099_04:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll defeat you and bring the future to this world!
　And whatever awaits beyond that,
　I will move forward together with the world!!」

stage0099_04:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Foolish soldier.
　Can words reach one like you, who abandoned
　your own judgment and just obeys orders?」

stage0099_04:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$宗介$$
「I may not be a clever man,
　but I can't stay silent at being called a foolish soldier」

stage0099_04:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am a professional.
　And a professional, no matter the circumstances,
　carries out the mission and gives everything to return alive」

stage0099_04:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Because all you can think of is what's in front of you,
　you people...」

stage0099_04:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$宗介$$
「Lecturing in front of the enemy? Already assuming victory?」

stage0099_04:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$宗介$$
「I've no reason to be called a foolish soldier
　by a third-rater licking their lips over their prey!」

stage0099_04:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　You may be a prophet,
　but to me, you're a third-rate soldier!」

stage0099_04:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll prove that to you right now!」

stage0099_04:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Why do you people not understand!
　This universe's crisis!」

stage0099_04:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「You pity me!?」

stage0099_04:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's right!
　You stopped time for the people of your own world,
　and now, out of nothing but a sense of duty, destroy other worlds!」

stage0099_04:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I want to stop you,
　who had no choice but to live that way!」

stage0099_04:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「No, no, no, no, no, no!
　Don't you pity me!」

stage0099_04:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Please, stop this!
　I'm sure if we all combine our strength,
　we can face even a crisis of the universe!」

stage0099_04:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Silence!
　You who bear the power of the Wings!
　Have you forgotten the anger and hatred of the past?」

stage0099_04:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So fighting is all that's left...」

stage0099_04:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$アマタ$$
「If fighting is all that's left, I won't hesitate!
　I'll fight with everything I have!」

stage0099_04:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Together with the one I love, to protect
　the life of this world! That's why I fight!!」

stage0099_04:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「The Spiral Nemesis!
　Before the Primal Catastrophe arrives,
　all of you must perish!」

stage0099_04:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Humanity will not lose...!
　No matter what hardship comes, we'll gather our wisdom
　and stand against it!」

stage0099_04:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ is proof of that courage!
　And I, who ride it, will never give up either!」

stage0099_04:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It's futile!
　The emergence of $$バアル$$ is nothing but a trivial matter!
　A far greater catastrophe will come eventually!」

stage0099_04:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「If the catastrophe you speak of is coming,
　then we'll fight that too!」

stage0099_04:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「We fight to win the future!
　This $$ガンバスター$$ is the strength for exactly that!!」

stage0099_04:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Man of the Spiral!」

stage0099_04:r_1ce9868e47e05f97.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've said all there is to say!
　Now it's a clash between our souls and yours!」

stage0099_04:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Very well!
　There, know your own powerlessness!!」

stage0099_04:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've known that for a long time now!」

stage0099_04:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「What did you say!?」

stage0099_04:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text:
$$シモン$$
「But you know!
　Even so, I've kept moving forward!
　Spinning the drill in my chest, even if just a little at a time!」

stage0099_04:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$シモン$$
「I have friends who believe in me and lend me their strength!
　I have a woman I love!」

stage0099_04:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Such things are meaningless!
　All will be lost before the Spiral Nemesis!」

stage0099_04:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$$シモン$$
「I fight to protect that!
　I won't lose to despair, to you, or to myself!」

stage0099_04:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's who I am!
　The way of life of a man called Digger $$シモン$$!」

stage0099_04:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$シモン$$
「Here I come, $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$!
　My drill will pierce right through you
　and blast open a path to the future!!」

stage0099_04:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「It seems even among the humans of Earth,
　there are those trying to protect themselves from the Primal Catastrophe!」

stage0099_04:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「And it's the very linchpin of that
　which you're piloting!?」

stage0099_04:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I have no intention of listening to what you say!」

stage0099_04:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「So you look away from the reality that is despair?」

stage0099_04:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Isn't it you who's looking away
　from reality!?」

stage0099_04:r_4f838d45a89974f0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Taking someone's life just to keep
　that Spiral Nemesis from happening
　is nothing but running away!」

stage0099_04:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't run away!
　I have to stand and face it!」

stage0099_04:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's why I pilot EVA!
　To change something with my own strength!
　And I'll defeat you and protect the world!」

stage0099_04:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「So you've gotten your hands on the twelve cursed fragments!?」

stage0099_04:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「To think you'd invite catastrophe upon yourselves!
　All that awaits in your future is despair!」

stage0099_04:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$n
「You're caught wavering between anger and resignation.
　That's why you can't forgive us
　for trying to stand against despair」

stage0099_04:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Silence!
　I hold not a shred of doubt about the mission I set upon myself!」

stage0099_04:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$n
「Getting worked up doesn't suit someone playing guardian of the universe!」

stage0099_04:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$n
「If someone means to destroy us,
　we'll resist with everything we have!
　We won't yield to the despair you speak of!」

stage0099_04:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$n
「We'll break through you and push onward!
　Whatever future waits beyond that,
　that is the world we'll live in!!」

stage0099_04:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
（Impossible...!
　This feeling... something I should have long since cast away
　is welling up from within me!）

stage0099_04:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
（Why!?
　To me, who abandoned my own kind, my homeworld, my future!
　Why!?）

stage0099_04:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
（Is there no choice but to accept it!
　That this is human potential!）

stage0099_04:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
「Could this adorableness save the universe!?」
